statements.t: The Company establishes an allowance as an estimate of the expected credit losses in the loan portfolio at the balance sheet date.
Management believes the allowance for credit losses is appropriate based upon management’s best estimate of expected losses within the existing loan portfolio.

Should any of the factors considered by management in evaluating the appropriate level of the allowance for credit losses change, the Company’s estimate of expected credit losses could also change which could affect the amount of future provisions for credit losses.
At acquisition, the Company identified these loans as credit deteriorated and recorded reserves for expected credit losses.

risks.t: the performance of financial markets and interest rates
legislative and regulatory actions and reforms
other factors, all of which change over time
